mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.5% signals labor market deterioration and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery phase, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances during the early recovery phase when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI index level (CPIAUCSL > 225) indicates elevated inflation, prompting market concerns about monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high CPI index level (CPIAUCSL > 225) indicates monetary policy misstep, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year windows.
